title: Input tape chain value
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $w$ be a finite Boolean input string, and let $t,p$ be nonnegative integers. The input chain value at position $p$ is the input symbol in the configuration after $t$ steps if the input head position is at most $p$, and is absent otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
